patch.summary: Campaign Monitor cost guide: researched plan structure, free/trial flags, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: Campaign Monitor pricing is plan-gated across 4 researched tiers. No free plan confirmed in SoftwareGlimpse research. 30-day trial documented. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.
bullets: Free plan: not confirmed in SG data

blocks.heading: Campaign Monitor cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price Campaign Monitor against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Scope a time-boxed pilot; 30-day trial documented.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (email campaigns, newsletter builder, email templates) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: No forever free plan — trial only. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

steps.label: Pay up when Brand-conscious teams prioritizing email design/templates requires a paid unlock you will use weekly

blocks.title: Campaign Monitor cost mistakes to avoid

items.title: Cost trap 1
items.body: No forever free plan — trial only

items.title: Cost trap 2
items.body: Lite monthly send caps force upgrades for frequent senders

items.title: Cost trap 3
items.body: Premier jump is large vs Essentials at the same contact band

items.title: Cost trap 4
items.body: Some advanced features / website builder may be add-ons or higher-tier only

items.title: Cost trap 5
items.body: Price rises sharply with contact band; 50,001+ often requires sales

blocks.title: Cheaper or clearer alternatives to pressure-test
blocks.body: Compare total cost of ownership vs Campaign Monitor on identical constraints.
